headword: {専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}

definitions.explanation: A married woman who does not have paid employment outside the home and devotes herself to household management and childcare.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}だった。
examples.english: My mother was a full-time housewife.

examples.japanese: {専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The number of full-time housewives is decreasing year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}{復帰|ふっき}→社会復帰：20417_shakaifukki⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Now that childcare has settled down, I'm thinking about returning to work from being a full-time housewife.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{専業|せんぎょう}→専業：15394_sengyou⟧ (exclusive occupation) and ⟦{主婦|しゅふ}→主婦：03225_shufu⟧ (housewife). Commonly discussed in the context of changing social roles, work-life balance, and demographics in Japan. The male equivalent is ⟦{専業主夫|せんぎょうしゅふ}→専業主夫：20248_sengyoushufu⟧ (stay-at-home husband), written with a different kanji for the last character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧ (single-income household with a stay-at-home wife)
- {専業主婦|せんぎょうしゅふ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働き：03557_hataraki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to enter the workforce after being a housewife)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{主婦|しゅふ}→主婦：03225_shufu⟧: housewife — broader term that includes both working and non-working wives
- ⟦{共働|ともばたら}き→共働き：08564_tomobataraki⟧: dual-income couple — the opposite household arrangement
